Subject: Pilot: procurement audit — potential pause of trial window

Hi Markus,

Quick note from procurement: we received an upstream audit request this morning tied to our vendor onboarding. Finance legal flagged the PO for additional review — this is unrelated to product but it's holding approvals.

We have an active pilot with Redwood (Helix integration), and the timer is going to expire in 6 days. Procurement says they won't clear the PO for at least 10 business days while they complete the checklist. Can you help by either briefly pausing the trial countdown or issuing a short interim credit so our engineers can keep validating the integration?

If helpful, I can loop in our procurement lead, James Park (james.park@pulsehealth.com). We appreciate anything short-term to avoid losing momentum.

Attachments: procurement_audit_notice.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Bethany

Hi Bethany — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the audit notice. I'm sorry to hear the PO is being held up.

We can absolutely help keep the pilot alive while procurement completes the review. I can approve a short-term runway: 5 business days of time freeze plus a 1,500-token voucher for immediate usage while the PO is in audit. If you need a longer window we can escalate to Sales Ops for an exception.

Before I finalize, could you confirm the procurement contact (James?) and whether they require any additional security evidence from us (SOC2, DPA, etc.) — happy to point them to our compliance pack. If you approve, I'll ask Camila from CS to apply the voucher and Kim in Sales Ops to record the concession against DEAL-8942.

—Markus
